notes: מַעֲלוֹת רוּחֲכֶם is split so the recast relative expression *the things that come* stays with מַעֲלוֹת (rule 46's Hebrew-noun rider, headed on *come* by rule 31's subtraction) and *into ... mind* goes to the rectum under rule 19. The competing reading heads the first unit on *things*, and the unit note records it.
The object suffix הָ of יְדַעְתִּיהָ is `unrepresented` rather than folded into the fronted noun phrase, per rule 22.
